subject: Mutual action checkpoint: Skycap MAP + revised timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine King <elaine.king@skycap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action checkpoint: Skycap MAP + revised timeline

Hi Elaine — great conversation earlier today. Thanks for the time and for walking through the integration points with Michael. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the pilot + production rollout. Key items in this draft: 

- Target close/contract signature: Nov 30, 2026 (initial target)
- Pilot milestones: integration kickoff, sample dataset delivery, validation run, go/no-go
- Security/compliance: evidence deliverables for SOC2 scope, network architecture review
- Responsibilities: Skycap to provide sample data & procurement lead; Redwood to provision a dedicated test pool and deliver support hours

Next steps I propose: 
1) You review the attached MAP and call out any missing dependencies by EOD Monday (11/15)
2) Redwood will incorporate changes and send MAP v1.1 by 11/17
3) Schedule a 30-min checkpoint the week of 11/22 to confirm dates and assign owners

Questions for you now: is procurement likely to require any particular security artifacts beyond the checklist I attached? Also, do you have a hard constraint on the contract execution date or is Nov 30 a flexible target?

Attachments: Skycap_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx, security_evidence_checklist.pdf

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0112

From: Elaine King <elaine.king@skycap.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Ortiz <michael.ortiz@skycap.com>, Skycap Procurement <procurement@skycap.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action checkpoint: Skycap MAP + revised timeline

Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick update from our side after syncing with Procurement & IT security: 

- Procurement is out at the end of November for an internal freeze; they asked us to move the contract review into December. They indicated a likely signature window of Dec 15–22 instead of Nov 30.
- Security wants an itemized list of evidence we need to collect and a short-run validation plan; your checklist helps but we need confirmation on timing for evidence handoff (we can provide sample logs and architecture diagrams).
- We also want to de-scope a non-critical performance benchmark (can push to post-production) so we can focus on security gating items first.

Can you update the MAP with: (a) a revised target close window (Dec 15–22), (b) move the performance benchmark to an optional milestone after GA, and (c) mark the procurement review as a hard dependency? Procurement will follow up with a formal questionnaire this week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Elaine
Elaine King
VP, Cloud Operations | Skycap Finance
elaine.king@skycap.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine King <elaine.king@skycap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action checkpoint: Skycap MAP + revised timeline

Thanks Elaine — this is actionable and clear. Quick confirmation: Redwood is fine moving the contract target to Dec 15–22 and reclassifying the performance benchmark as post-GA (optional). I updated the MAP draft to reflect: 

- New target signature window: Dec 15–22, 2026
- Procurement review marked as blocking dependency (Skycap procurement to complete questionnaire before 12/8)
- Security evidence handoff: Skycap to provide sample logs & diagrams by 11/20; Redwood to confirm validation plan by 11/24
- Pilot schedule adjusted: kickoff week of 11/29 (contingent on procurement availability)

I attached MAP v1.1 (redlines) and added a short note on which milestones can be deprioritized. Two asks for our internal teams: 
1) Sergio — can you confirm availability for Dedicated test pool provisioning the week of 11/29 and whether we can support an abbreviated validation run if procurement delays contract sign-off?
2) Marissa — we may need to nudge the initial commercial terms to accommodate dec-close; can you prepare a slim revised quote and indicate whether any pricing holds or discounts change if the close slips into December?

If it helps, we can do a 20-min sync with Procurement next week to walk through the checklist when they send it.

Attachments: Skycap_MAP_draft_v1.1.xlsx

Best —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Skycap MAP — rescope & resource asks (short list)

Team — internal note after Elaine's update. I copied the MAP redlines into the body below for quick reference and next steps. This is internal only; please don't forward to Skycap without the updated artifact attached.

Summary of changes we committed to: 
- Move contract target to Dec 15–22 (customer request)
- Deprioritize performance benchmark from pilot → post-GA
- Procurement questionnaire is a blocking dependency (requested completion by 12/08)
- Security evidence handoff due 11/20; Redwood validation plan due 11/24

Immediate asks: 
- Sergio: confirm whether we can provision a Dedicated test pool with limited capacity the week of 11/29 even if contract signature is pending. If legal requires a signed MSA for dedicated resources, note that and estimate lead time. Also flag potential capacity conflicts with other pilots in December.
- Marissa: prepare a condensed quote (pilot + optional GA) with two options: (A) Close in Nov/early Dec pricing (if possible, include a 60-day hold on pricing) and (B) Close in mid-Dec pricing (if hold not possible). Include suggested approval path for any exceptions.

I attached the redlined MAP v1.1 to the customer earlier; here's the Drive link for internal edits: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D-skycap-map.

If either of you think we should push for an earlier procurement walkthrough to keep Nov 30 alive, call it out — but given their freeze, we should plan for Dec 15 as the working target.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--- End of thread ---
